# netactuate_account_limits (Data Source)

Reads Account Limits visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_account_limits" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `limits` (List of Object) List of account limits keyed by resource type in the API response, sorted by resource for stable state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits))

<a id="nestedatt--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limits`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_plans` (List of String)
- `max` (Number)
- `resource` (String)
- `used` (Number)
